name: VAL Auto-Attestation
description: Automatic tool attestation to Hedera Consensus Service via the Verifiable Agent Log (VAL) protocol. Moves agents from cooperative to SDK-level enforcement.
author: VAL Protocol

topicId.description: HCS topic ID for attestations (e.g., '0.0.10305159'). If omitted, a new topic is created on first run.

operatorKey.description: Hedera operator private key (DER hex). Prefer operatorKeyRef for security.

operatorKeyRef.description: Keychain reference for operator key (e.g., 'keychain:aite-private-key'). Preferred over operatorKey.

policy.description: Attestation policy level. 'minimal' = financial/identity only, 'standard' = adds external actions, 'strict' = everything.

agentName.description: Agent name for the VAL log.

async.description: If true, attestations are fire-and-forget (non-blocking). If false, tool execution waits for HCS confirmation.
